race.comment: LA MORRA (5) demolished inferior opposition two back at Kembla Grange over 1600m second up. Stalked the good speed along the inside and battled on okay to secure fourth over 1800m at Randwick. Ready for this trip and has the speed to hold a position from the draw. Top three contender. CABBUCIO (6) dropped back in trip with a fighting on speed third over 1600m at Newcastle in this grade. Desperate for this distance range and looks ready to deliver from the rails draw. SAINT EMILION (3) win record hardly excites but working himself into form. Up sharply in grade and trip with a gritty on speed second over 2400m at this track in BM78 class. Key jockey change and worth serious consideration. BEARINGS (9) proven at the trip and gets one more chance fourth up with the senior jockey aboard. Kept safe in betting with a fading last over 1900m at Canterbury. Well drawn again and assess on the solid Hawkesbury placing. DARN CUTE (4) will roll forward from the better gate and has place claims.
